title: Rabbi Acha bar Zevina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bamidbar Rabbah 8:4. Hyman calls this a scribal error, for the source of the statement is in Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin, chapter 4, halakhah 1, where it reads Rabbi Abba bar Zimna.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The correction from Acha bar Zevina to Abba bar Zimna is Hyman’s textual judgment.

Numbers Rabbah 8:4 reads Rabbi Acha bar Zevina in Rabbi Hoshaya’s name; Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 4:1 reads Rabbi Abba bar Zemina in the parallel discourse. The spelling Zimna and the assertion that one is an error remain Hyman’s wording and judgment.
